div.head: Ine 17
div.ab: LXI. Se ðe forstolen flæsc findeð ⁊ gedyrneð, gif he dear, he mot mid aðe gecyðan, þæt he hit age; se ðe hit ofspyreð, he ah ðæt meldfeoh.
LXI. Se þe forstolen flæsc findeð ⁊ gederneð, gif he dear, he mot mid aðe ge…, þæt he hit age; se ðe hit ofspereð, he ah þæt meldfeoh.
LXI. Se ðe forstolen flæsc findeð ⁊ gedirneð, gif he dear, he mot mid aðe gecyðan, ðæt he hit áge; se þe hit ofspyreð, he ah ðæt meldfeoh.
Be forstolenum flæsce. Se ðe forstolen flæsc findeð ⁊ gedyrneð, gyf he dear, he mot mid aþe gecyðan, þæt he hit áge; se þe hit ofspyrað, he ah þæt meldfeoh.

Qui furtiuam carnem inuenerit et celatam (occultatam), si audeat, licet ei inueritare cum iuramento (iureiurando), quod sua sit. Qui inuestigabit eam, habeat þæt meldefeoh (id est pecuniam indicationis uel delaturam).
[Be forstolenum flæsce.] Se ðe forstolen flæsc findeð ⁊ gedyrned, gif he dear, he mot mid aðe gecyðan þæt he hit age; se ðe hit ofspyreð, he ah ðæt meldfeoh.
{LXI} Se ðe forstolen flæsc findeð ⁊ gedyrneð, gif he dear, he mot mid aðe gecyðan ðæt he hit age; se ðe hit ofspyreð, he ah ðæt meldfeoh.
Wer gestohlenes und verstecktes Fleisch findet, darf durch Eid, wenn er [ihn] wagt, beweisen, dass es ihm gehöre; wer es aufspürt, der erhält den Anzeigelohn.
Whoever finds stolen and hidden meat may prove by oath, if he dares [to swear it], that it belongs to him; whoever tracks it down receives the informer’s reward.
He who finds meat which has been stolen and hidden shall be allowed, if he dare, to declare on oath that it is his property. He who traces it shall have the reward to which an informer is entitled.
He who finds stolen and hidden meat, may, if he dares, declare with an oath that he owns it; he who traces it has the reward due to an informer.
He who finds stolen meat and hides it, if he dare, may declare with an oath that he owns it; the one who traces it gets the reward due an informant.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: The reward may well be equivalent to the 10 shillings for a person who turns in a thief described in §28.

Die Beweisnähe (s. d. Gl 6. 8) verliert der Beklagte dadurch, dass er seine Tat verhehlt hat; s. Gl Spurfolge 3. Als jemandem Schweine gestohlen waren, ridon his men tó ⁊ tugon ut þæt spic ut of A.’s huse. Der Dieb A. entfloh und ward geächtet; Urk. a. 995 Ke 692

The defendant loses the nearer right to proof (see that word in Gl 6. 8) by having concealed his act; see Gl Spurfolge 3. When someone’s pigs had been stolen, ridon his men tó ⁊ tugon ut þæt spic ut of A.’s huse. The thief A. fled and was outlawed; charter a. 995 Ke 692
Vgl. Gl Anzeige 8. Zu trennen hiervon ist ‘Einfang’ (s. d. Gl), d. i. Ergreiferlohn des abhanden gekommenen Viehs
Cf. Gl Anzeige 8. To be distinguished from this is ‘Einfang’ (see that word in Gl), i.e. the captor’s reward for stray livestock
